blockingFindings.title: Test coverage artifact paths changed
blockingFindings.issue: `TestCoverageArtifact` now records coverage file paths relative to the repository root instead of the spec directory, changing persisted `test-review` coverage artifact values from paths like `tests/example.test.js` to `specs/demo/tests/example.test.js`. T-4 explicitly says the runtime repair must make no user-facing command contract changes, and this is unrelated to the resumption repairs in R10.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Restore `TestCoverageArtifact` and `TestFileCoverageEntry` to compute paths relative to `absoluteSpecDir`/`specDir`, and remove or update the new unit assertion so it preserves the existing spec-local artifact contract.
blockingFindings.rationale: The task acceptance criteria include a mandatory no-contract-change guardrail. Changing persisted command artifact path semantics is a user-facing command contract change, so this must be repaired before acceptance.
